data_fields.name: topic_sort_key
data_fields.donor_constant: info.nr (rule: sort by key then function id)

best_idea: Store a conversation topic as data with a condition, a repeat flag and an important tier, pick the choice list in one fixed order (important tier first; heard-once topics skipped unless repeatable; an important repeatable topic not repeated inside one talk), and record heard marks per player and per topic, saved with the game.
decision_why: Take the selection order and the known, repeat and except rules, but evaluate the condition and keep the known set server-side in the one ledger, keyed by player. The donor mutates a shared object for used sub-choices and has two predicates that disagree (dialogChoices vs npc_checkinfo defaults), so both must become one function.
acceptance: A server test talks to the same NPC twice as one player: a one-time topic is offered once and gone on the second talk, a repeatable important greeting plays once per talk and again next talk, a second player still sees the one-time topic, and npcCheckInfo and the choice list agree for the same state.
